title: Perfect
body: It’s a very useful app, the main point is the you do not have to pay any thing or do thing to get points, it clear and not difficult to use, so I’d recommend a lot
author: Manoela11

title: Finally a free habit tracker
body: Lately I’ve been looking for a habit tracker all through App Store and all the options were in some way or another paid stuff. This app has a clean interface, no adds, or a bad free version so you are obligated to sign up for a premium version. It’s really simple to understand and nice to use on a daily basis.
author: Joaquina0202
